title: Nirmaan Integrated Platform
description: A production enterprise platform for managing project requests, approval workflows, role-based access control, notifications, and organizational administration.
highlights: Developed production features using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and tRPC.
Built project request workflows, dashboards, and administrative modules.
Developed type-safe backend APIs using tRPC, PostgreSQL, and Drizzle ORM.
Contributed to authentication, role-based access control, and user management.
Built reusable responsive interfaces using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
Improved API and frontend performance through optimized data fetching and rendering.
Contributed to testing, debugging, code reviews, and production deployments.

title: HYSEA CSR & Impact Hiring
description: A production web platform supporting CSR initiatives and impact hiring by connecting NGOs, corporate partners, and job seekers.
highlights: Developed responsive interfaces using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
Built business workflows for CSR initiatives and impact hiring.
Integrated backend APIs for dynamic data management.
Worked with PostgreSQL and ORM-based data operations.
Built reusable UI components following modern frontend practices.

title: AI Sales Planning & Decision Assistant
description: An AI-powered sales planning assistant that combines organizational knowledge with structured sales data to answer business questions and support sales decision-making.
highlights: Building an LLM-powered workflow using LangGraph to coordinate RAG and business tools.
Developing RAG using embeddings, semantic search, PostgreSQL, and pgvector.
Building read-only business tools for quota attainment, account assignments, and territory information.
Integrating MCP to expose business tools through a standardized interface.
Using parameterized database queries and restricted tool access instead of allowing arbitrary SQL execution.
Developing FastAPI APIs and a Next.js interface for interacting with the assistant.

title: Real-Time Chat Application
description: A full-stack real-time messaging application featuring live communication and a responsive user experience.
highlights: Implemented real-time messaging using Socket.io.
Built responsive UI using React and TypeScript.
Implemented user session handling and message validation.
Developed backend services using Node.js and Express.js.
Designed reusable chat components and client-side state management.
